# A new authored interaction, not a bundled example.
state x = 500
state moving = 0
state count = 0
input advance = ArrowRight
input pulse = Space
box marker(x, 170, 48, 48, "#7ed9ae")
text reading(40, 70, count, "Signals: ")
on advance.down { moving = 1 }
on advance.up { moving = 0 }
on pulse.down { count = count + 5 }
on frame { x = clamp(x + moving * 120 * dt, 0, 580) }
state bonus = 7
input reverse = KeyA
circle beacon(300, 190, 15 + bonus, "#c9f08b")
on reverse.down { bonus = bonus + 2 }
# This un-applied draft must survive Reset.
